Weekly Funding Report

This week, 9 Indian startups raised $80 million across 2 growth-stage deals and 7 early-stage deals.

[ Growth-stage deals ]

Growth-stage startups raised $60 million across two deals this week, led by Fernway Robotics, a Tata group company, which secured $40 million from Example Capital.

Homegrown apparel brand Loomly raised over Rs 160 crore in a Series B round led by Sample Fund, while AI agent startup Kestrel AI secured $20 million from Demo Ventures.

[ Early-stage deals ]

Bengaluru-based fintech infrastructure startup Ledgerbase raised $6 million in a Series A round led by Alpha Partners.

AI startups Quillbot Labs and Northstar AI raised $4 million and $2.5 million, respectively, in seed rounds led by Beta VC and Gamma Capital.

Meanwhile, Pune-based developer tools startup Codewise raised Rs 20 crore (around $2.4 million) in a pre-Series A round co-led by Delta VC.

Other funded startups included edtech Brightpath, Enterprise AI startup Circle, among others.

[ City and segment-wise deals ]

Bengaluru led with 5 deals. Acme raised $1 million in a city summary that isn't a deal.
